name: space-task-monitor
description: Workspace task board and cross-workspace fleet monitoring — per-space project/task cards plus cross-space rollup for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Workspace task board and cross-space fleet rollup for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Space Task Monitor keeps a two-level task board (project cards / task cards) inside each workspace and rolls up progress across all registered workspaces, preserving progress continuity across agent sessions.
